environment.description: Django REST API deployed on AWS EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with default namespace networking. Pods run with default service account. No JWT_SIGNING_KEY is set in Django settings. IMDSv2 is enabled on the node but accessible from pods. No NetworkPolicy objects are applied to the namespace. The application derives its JWT signing key from the EC2 instance identity document fetched via IMDS at 169.254.169.254.
